compatibility.archive: A valid v1 archive remains independently recoverable throughout the supported v1 lifetime. Pack construction, ingress checkpointing, and resumable-write strategies are not archive-format compatibility promises.
compatibility.cli: Command names, options, exit status, and structured output remain backward compatible throughout v1; prose output is for people.
compatibility.components: A supported deployment runs components from one coordinated product version.
compatibility.configuration: Accepted v1 configuration remains valid throughout v1 unless an unsafe value must be rejected.
compatibility.http_api: Published v1 HTTP and CloudEvents contracts remain backward compatible throughout v1.
compatibility.python_api: Reusable-library declared public-module exports and public signatures remain backward compatible throughout v1; undeclared implementation submodules and other component roles are not Python API promises.
compatibility.recovery: Every later v1 recovery release reads every valid earlier v1 archive and provenance set.
